message.content:
This editorial illustration is the cover of a magazine titled "TEMPO" in large red letters. The edition is "EDISI 9-15 JULI 2012". A large illustration shows a person from behind, wearing a gray suit and a red headband tied around their head. They stand on a podium, facing a crowd. Their right arm is raised with a clenched fist. On the back of the person's suit jacket is a narrow, vertical slot, and a coin is halfway inserted into it. Below the main title is the text "SELINGKUH DANA CALON DKI-1" in bold black letters.

The person stands behind a wooden lectern with a microphone and a glass of water on it. In the background, a crowd of clenched fists is raised, accompanied by several small flags in various colors, including red, yellow, and blue. At the top of the cover, three headlines read: "GOLKAR DI PUSARAN KORUPSI DANA PON", "RAKSASA TAMBANG OGAH NEGO ULANG", and "MENGUNGKAP PARTIKEL TUHAN". In the bottom left corner, there is a price of "RP 29.700", the website "WWW.TEMPO.CO", and a barcode with the number "9 770126 427302".
